name: Acronym
blurb: Convert a long phrase to its acronym.
instructions:
# Instructions

Convert a phrase to its acronym.

Techies love their TLA (Three Letter Acronyms)!

Help generate some jargon by writing a program that converts a long name like Portable Network Graphics to its acronym (PNG).

Punctuation is handled as follows: hyphens are word separators (like whitespace); all other punctuation can be removed from the input.

For example:

| Input                     | Output |
| ------------------------- | ------ |
| As Soon As Possible       | ASAP   |
| Liquid-crystal display    | LCD    |
| Thank George It's Friday! | TGIF   |
starter_code:
# Determine a sentence's acronym
# Acronym ? Sentence
Acronym ← |1 ⊙(⍤"Please implement Acronym" 0)
test_code:
~ "acronym.ua" ~ Acronym

# ignoring punctuation and casing?
⍤⤙≍ "CMOS" Acronym "Complementary metal-oxide semiconductor"

# ignores punctuation?
⍤⤙≍ "FIFO" Acronym "First In, First Out"

# from phrases with acronyms?
⍤⤙≍ "GIMP" Acronym "GNU Image Manipulation Program"

# from phrases with apostrophes?
⍤⤙≍ "HC" Acronym "Halley's Comet"

# from title case?
⍤⤙≍ "PNG" Acronym "Portable Network Graphics"

# from lower case?
⍤⤙≍ "ROR" Acronym "Ruby on Rails"

# from a very long abbreviation?
⍤⤙≍ "ROTFLSHTMDCOALM" Acronym "Rolling On The Floor Laughing So Hard That My Dogs Came Over And Licked Me"

# from phrases with consecutive delimiters?
⍤⤙≍ "SIMUFTA" Acronym "Something - I made up from thin air"

# from phrases with underscore emphasis?
⍤⤙≍ "TRNT" Acronym "The Road _Not_ Taken"
